title: South Korea’s high-stakes university exams upended by AI cheating scandal
summary_full: South Korea has been gripped by revelations of AI-aided cheating, just days before more than half a million students are to sit high-stakes entrance examsThe integrity of South Korea’s career-defining university entrance exam has been thrown into doubt after the top scorer in a recent professional exam admitted using a concealed camera and AI to cheat.On Thursday, more than half a million people, mostly school students, are due to sit the exam, known as the suneung, at 1,312 centres across the country. The exam runs for a gruelling eight hours over a single day and determines which university a candidate can attend and, in turn, their future prospects. Continue reading...
